An organization chart showing the structure of the Nigerian Legislature in the Fourth Republic. Top box: "The National Assembly (Bicameral)". Below it, two branching boxes. Left box: "The Senate (109 members: 3 per state + 1 FCT), Led by President of the Senate". Right box: "House of Representatives (360 members based on population), Led by the Speaker". Below the main branch, a separate floating box: "State Houses of Assembly (Unicameral, 36 states), Led by State Speakers". Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
